## F16.sdk-api — SDK and API

Definition: Libraries or APIs to drive the agent.
- claude-code [supported, unverified] The SDK is driven through query() calls: every call accepts an options object (Options in TypeScript, ClaudeAgentOptions in Python), a Python query() returns an async iterator that yields messages as they arrive, and the SDK includes the same tools that power Claude Code. allowedTools can pre-approve tools such as Read, Edit and Glob. | ev: E-claude-code-00279, E-claude-code-00161, E-claude-code-00490, E-claude-code-00750
- codex-cli [partial, verified] The Python SDK controls the local Codex app-server over JSON-RPC, requires Python 3.10 or later, and published SDK builds include a pinned Codex CLI runtime dependency. The app-server is a local JSON-RPC server for embedding Codex threads, turns, approvals, history, and streamed events in custom clients. | limit: Launching the app server locally is 'primarily for development and debugging and may change without notice.' | ev: E-codex-cli-00377, E-codex-cli-01671, E-codex-cli-01134
- copilot-cli [supported, unverified] The copilot command's --acp option starts the CLI's ACP server, in stdio mode if no transport mode is specified, or with --port. The -p flag lets the CLI be used programmatically within scripts. Extensions add tools and slash commands using only the SDK that ships with the CLI, and a workflow can also be started from other code that uses the GitHub Copilot SDK. | ev: E-copilot-cli-00809, E-copilot-cli-02227, E-copilot-cli-00025, E-copilot-cli-01895
- copilot-vscode [supported, unverified] The Copilot harness uses the GitHub Copilot SDK to access the agent runtime also used by Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app; no separate SDK install is needed in VS Code. Agent Host Protocol is an open, agent-agnostic JSON-RPC protocol between a host and its clients. The Language Model API lets extensions use the language model and integrate AI-powered features. | ev: E-copilot-vscode-02418, E-copilot-vscode-01896, E-copilot-vscode-00036
- cursor [supported, unverified] An API call can create a Cloud Agent and immediately enqueue its initial run; the response returns the durable agent and the initial run. `Agent.create()` takes either `local` or `cloud` to pick a runtime, and a local runtime runs the agent loop inline in your Node process. `agent acp` runs Cursor CLI as an ACP server over stdio with JSON-RPC messaging. | ev: E-cursor-00370, E-cursor-01120, E-cursor-01221, E-cursor-01886
- gemini-cli [supported, unverified] v0.30.0 introduced the initial SDK package. ACP mode is a special operational mode of Gemini CLI. --output-format accepts text, json or stream-json. The core package can be used as a standalone package in other projects, if needed. | ev: E-gemini-cli-01122, E-gemini-cli-01305, E-gemini-cli-00008, E-gemini-cli-01032
- grok-build [supported, unverified] `grok agent stdio` runs Grok as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout. `session/prompt` returns completion metadata; the assistant text itself arrives as `session/update` chunks. | ev: E-grok-build-00218, E-grok-build-00227
